name: Lantern Masjid
summary: A tall carved minaret anchors a low domed hall, whose doorway opens into a coral beam of light.
why: The tall left minaret and domed hall are physically joined. The doorway, dome and expanding light share x=59. The light follows the doorway geometry, separated from the wall by deliberate negative space. One tall lancet pierces the minaret.
risk: At 24 px the tower lancet becomes a fine slot and the light reads as a warm entrance; the expanding beam is clearest at 48 px and above.
sub1: A shared axis from crown to threshold
sub2: One minaret balances the low domed hall
